description: This file defines type annotations for request parameter structures used in interacting with the Recraft API, specifically for image generation and editing. It includes TypedDict classes specifying optional and required parameters for making API requests related to image processing.

classes.name: RecraftImageGenerationRequestParams
classes.description: TypedDict for parameters used in image generation requests via the Recraft API, including prompts, styles, size, and response format.

classes.name: RecraftImageEditRequestParams
classes.description: TypedDict for parameters used in image editing requests via the Recraft API, including prompt, strength, style, model, and output settings.
